Material flow: Smelter → trader/importer or direct buyer → regional stock → melt shop
Commercial role / quality checkpoint: Ingot sold to an approved specification; inventory separates the timing of production and consumption
Documented example or boundary: USITC describes factory or warehouse deliveries to users; Platts defines a Rotterdam warehouse market. This illustrates a channel, not a traced shipment.

Material flow: Primary Mg + alloy additions → alloy ingot → diecaster → component buyer
Commercial role / quality checkpoint: Alloy maker controls composition; component qualification is a later step
Documented example or boundary: Baowu’s component relationships and Magontec’s alloy business demonstrate downstream conversion. A named carmaker is not automatically a primary-ingot purchaser.

Material flow: Casting returns / machining scrap → segregated collection → recycler → alloy customer
Commercial role / quality checkpoint: Scrap condition and contamination affect acceptance and value; metal is already metallic
Documented example or boundary: Magontec documents its recycling business; Luxfer describes acceptance of chips and swarf. Recovered alloy output is separate from new primary supply.

Material flow: Mg metal → titanium reduction → returned MgCl2 → electrolysis → Mg metal
Commercial role / quality checkpoint: Internal regeneration; gross circulation can repeat the same Mg atoms
Documented example or boundary: UKTMP’s internal consumer and regeneration loop; no second count as virgin primary metal.

Material flow: Ingot → powder / granule producer → steel-treatment or chemical user
Commercial role / quality checkpoint: Conversion changes form; powder sizing and chemistry are separately specified
Documented example or boundary: Luxfer Magtech product disclosure supports this route, without identifying individual customers.

Material flow: Mg alloy → cast anode → distributor → corrosion-protection application
Commercial role / quality checkpoint: A finished anode is sold for protective performance rather than bulk-metal assay alone
Documented example or boundary: Yinguang → Newport is a documented cast-anode distribution relationship. Do not generalize it to every product Newport sells.
